author: moneydeep
text:
I set pending orders and alerts once they hit just to take a look at
the reaction. I think if you have a level marked correctly price is
going to bounce as there are unfilled orders there. I like to take a
look what happens after the level is hit and want to see a good spike
and quick departure from the level.

Look for gaps where price has not returned to and you will start seeing
something. I remember someone used to call these large candles hidden
gaps. Combine these with LS kinks and you are looking for great areas to
 trade from. Here's a diagram that should help.
